title: SRPK3 Is Essential for Cognitive and Ocular Development in Humans and Zebrafish, Explaining X-Linked Intellectual Disability

reviewer.method: Personally read all419 lines of the held PMC author manuscript, including all54 references and seven figure legends; inspected all seven recovered original figure images at original resolution; individually compared all six assigned selected/alternate packets (89 phenotypes and six alleles). No supplement read credit: original DOCX unavailable. Extraction/retrieval are preparation only. No inherited paper-reading claim.

audit.exposure_note: Required HANDOFF reading exposed aggregate history and a historical public-control HG002/FGFR2 case-specific rank. No target-case inference ranks, inference-output files or benchmark outcome summaries consulted. This review is not blinded.
